schemes.name: Wager at Blackjack for Heroes' Souls
schemes.setupRule: Setup: 11 Twists. And two extra Heroes.
schemes.twistEffect: Twist: Reveal card from the Hero Deck, adding up their total cost until you choose to stop or your Total exceeds 21. If your Total exceeds 21 you “bust“ and the Mastermind wins the wager. If you didn't bust, then do the same thing for the Mastermind, stopping as soon as their Total is at least 17. If their Total exceeds 21, then they bust and you win the wager. If no one busts, then you win the wager if your Total is higher. It the Masterminds Total is equal or higher they win.
schemes.evilWins: Evil Wins: When there are 4 Wagered Souls.

schemes.twistEffect:

schemes.evilWins: Evil Wins: When all TV is destroyed.
